title: GUVI: Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter
description: Given a temperature in Celsius `c`, convert it to Fahrenheit using the formula F = (C * 9/5) + 32. Return the result rounded to 2 decimal places.
solution:
def c_to_f(c: float) -> float:
    return round((c * 9.0 / 5.0) + 32.0, 2)
explanation: Applies linear temperature transformation formula with precision rounding in O(1) time.
